text:
nora: Heads-up from a partner call: their SI wants a reference pattern for handling third-party license blobs when bundling marketplace images. Need guidance in the partner templates repo.

paul_infra: We should add a LICENSE_HANDLING.md. Recommendation: keep license blobs outside the image build, provide URIs in manifest, and include a script to fetch and attest at build time. For air-gapped, include an instructions file and checksums.

sachin_hw: Also add a note on GPU driver redistributables. Some drivers have additional licensing. For partners using marketplace AMIs, include a DRIVER_LICENSES.md and a verification step in the smoke test that checks license acceptance.

marketplace-bot: Note: marketplace manifest validators will reject manifests missing license metadata for redistributed components.

nora: Ok adding to the task list: 1) LICENSE_HANDLING.md 2) DRIVER_LICENSES.md 3) packaging script modifications to include license references 4) update smoke tests to verify license acceptance step.

paul_infra: I'll propose exact wording for the LICENSE_HANDLING.md and a small bash helper: fetch-licenses.sh --source-list licenses.yml --output ./licenses/ --verify-sha256.

sachin_hw: I'll prepare the driver license matrix and a short blurb about when partners need to obtain separate agreements.

nora: Thanks, will create a PR in partner-templates.
